Oil prices approach $100 amid global supply concerns

Global oil prices are nearing $100 per barrel due to a looming supply crunch. Analysts suggest that the high prices may eventually lead to a decline in demand, laying the groundwork for a future price drop. China, a major oil consumer, is reportedly relying on its existing stockpiles amidst the tightening global supply.
